blocks.title: Nested conditionals
blocks.text: Ek shart ke andar doosri shart jaanchna nesting kehlata hai: ek if statement doosre if ya else ke block ke andar rakha jata hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
weather = "rainy"
temperature = 10
if weather == "rainy":
....if temperature < 15:
........print("Wear a raincoat")
....else:
........print("Take an umbrella")
else:
....print("Enjoy your day!")
Agar barish ho aur 15 degree se kam ho to raincoat pehnein; sirf barish ho to chhatri lein; barish na ho to bas din enjoy karein. In qeematon ke saath program "Wear a raincoat" print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: weather = "rainy" aur temperature = 20 par program kya print karta hai?
blocks.explanation: "Take an umbrella": barish hai magar andar ki shart temperature < 15 jhooti hai.

items: Nested conditionals: if ke andar if; andar ka jaanch tabhi chalta hai jab bahar wala ijazat de.
